editorial.blurb: The Meadowlark crafts innovative cocktails with genuine care, earning its reputation as one of Chicago's best bars through thoughtfully balanced drinks and creative menus.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your bartender for low/no ABV options like The Moon or The Sun if you prefer lighter drinks, or go for Neptune or Jupiter if you want full-strength spirits—and don't miss the kimchi fries as a bar snack.
